Home page: card grid → stack matrix

Before: production (a grid of screenshot cards that said what each app is). After: local build with the production scan seeded, a matrix that says how each app is built. Read across a row for one app, or down a column to compare them.

What moved

  1. NEW Eight columns per app: Hosting, Frontend, Backend, Data, AI, Sign-in, Phone, Ships via.
  2. SCAN Hosting is read from the Azure scan ("Azure App Service · Linux, free tier", "Azure Static Web Apps"), so a plan move updates itself. Data falls back to "Azure Storage" when the app's resource group holds a storage account.
  3. CATALOG Everything else comes from a new stack block per app in apps.json, filled in from each repo's packages and CLAUDE.md.
  4. SMALLER The big 16:10 screenshot became a 104px thumbnail in the app cell; the name link, Down badge and streak flame live there too.
  5. ADDED PoFightJudge and PoRedoMedia now have catalog entries (they used to appear only through the scan, with "Open PoX." as a description).
  6. HIDDEN A column empty on every row of a table is not drawn: the RL games table has no Backend, Sign-in, Phone or Ships via columns.
  7. PHONE At 1200px and below each row becomes a labelled block, and empty lines are dropped; on a tablet the blocks tile two or three across.
  8. GONE The mouse tilt on cards (ui-physics.js): a tilting table row reads as a glitch.
